constraints.explanation: The path must start at the specified start point and end at the specified goal point.
All waypoints must have x and y coordinates within [0,100].

The path must maintain at least safety_distance clearance from every obstacle. For circular obstacles, each line segment between consecutive waypoints must not pass within obstacle radius plus safety_distance of the obstacle center.
All waypoint coordinates must be finite real numbers (no NaN or infinity).
The number of waypoints in the output path must not exceed max_waypoints.

description: Generate a 2D path from start to goal for a UAV in a 100x100 map, avoiding circular obstacles and minimizing exposure to rectangular risk zones. The path is represented as a sequence of waypoints. Constraints ensure endpoints are preserved, waypoints stay within map bounds and finite, maintain obstacle clearance based on safety distance, and do not exceed the maximum allowed waypoints. The objective minimizes a weighted sum of path length, collision penalty, smoothness penalty, risk exposure, and number of intermediate waypoints. Risk zones are soft costs and never hard obstacles.
objective: Minimize the configured weighted sum of total polyline length, one collision penalty per colliding path segment, the smoothness sum of squared normalized unsigned turn angles, zone-weighted path-segment length inside rectangular risk zones, and the number of intermediate waypoints. Risk zones are soft costs and never hard obstacles.
output: Return a feasible start-to-goal path as ordered 2D waypoints.
